description: Five end-to-end Phase 2 pilot pages using standardised named asset layouts, task-specific mechanics, print-readable typography, compact teacher cues and no parent/homework panel.

learning.objective: Read simple words and match each word to its picture.
learning.student_instruction: Read each word. Draw a line to the correct picture.
learning.expected_response: Child reads or sounds out seven familiar words and draws each line to the matching picture.

teacher.model: Ask the child to sound out each word before drawing the line.
teacher.question: Which picture matches this word?

guidance.parent_extension: No home task is assigned on this classroom page.

illustration.scene: Exactly seven unique isolated assets: cat, sun, bus, cup, pen, dog and hen. Each appears once on pure white.
illustration.focal_point: Seven clean picture assets that the Phase 2 composer places beside exact printed words.
protected_response_zones: line-drawing space between word and picture columns

learning.objective: Build confidence in speaking one clear sentence to a listener.
learning.student_instruction: Choose one picture. Say one sentence to your friend.
learning.expected_response: Child selects one familiar picture, speaks one supported sentence, and listens to a partner.

teacher.model: Model one calm sentence, then let each child choose and speak.
teacher.question: What did your friend choose?

guidance.parent_extension: No home task is assigned on this classroom page.

illustration.scene: One two-child speaking-and-listening model on the left plus exactly three isolated choice assets stacked on the right: red ball, blue toy car and teddy bear.
illustration.focal_point: One speaker, one attentive listener and three equal, extractable visual choices.
protected_response_zones: three deterministic choice positions and sentence starter

phase2.partner_cue: Point to the picture your friend spoke about.

learning.objective: Find and name four familiar objects in one simple scene.
learning.student_instruction: Look carefully. Find and point to each object.
learning.expected_response: Child finds, points to and names four familiar targets.

teacher.model: Name the first target, then let the child find the rest.
teacher.question: Where did you find it?

guidance.parent_extension: No home task is assigned on this classroom page.

illustration.scene: One simple park observation scene occupying the upper 64 percent plus exactly four isolated target assets in one equal bottom row: kite, bench, tree and flower.
illustration.focal_point: A controlled observation scene with four exact, extractable targets.

learning.objective: Identify and classify familiar living and non-living things.
learning.student_instruction: Look at each picture. Write its number in the correct group.
learning.expected_response: Child classifies six numbered pictures by writing each number under Living or Non-living and explains one choice.

teacher.model: Ask whether each thing grows, breathes or needs food, then let the child classify it.
teacher.question: Why does this belong in that group?

guidance.parent_extension: No home task is assigned on this classroom page.

illustration.scene: Exactly six unique isolated assets in a strict three-column by two-row grid with wide white gutters: top row dog, tree, butterfly; bottom row rock, car, book.
illustration.focal_point: Six clean, balanced assets for a numbered Living and Non-living classification activity.

learning.objective: Create and say one imaginative sentence, then listen and respond to a partner.
learning.student_instruction: Choose a character and situation. Say one clear sentence. Listen to your partner’s reply.
learning.expected_response: Child combines one character with one situation, speaks a clear imaginative sentence and listens to a reply.

teacher.model: Let partners choose, speak and reply once, then switch turns.
teacher.question: What did your partner’s character say?

guidance.parent_extension: No home task is assigned on this classroom page.

illustration.scene: One two-child puppet-speaking model in the top band, exactly three isolated character assets in the middle band, and exactly three isolated situation scenes in the bottom band with wide white separation.
illustration.focal_point: Choose one exact uploaded character and one exact uploaded situation, then speak, listen and reply.
